Inspired by the Ferrari SF90, the SF60 (Super Force) is a flagship 60% layout magnetic switch keyboard that integrates performance of magnetic switches with the tactile/auditory feedback of traditional mechanical keyboards. Achieving the ultimate balance between e-sports performance and mechanical acoustics, it stands as a benchmark in the high-end gaming market. HE performance
Rapid Trigger - Keys can be re-triggered without returning to the original position, increasing high-frequency operation speed by up to 80%.
Dynamic Keystroke - Unlock up to 4 actions on a single key by assigning different commands to different levels of key travel. Each trigger point can be individually customized, enabling complex inputs, faster execution, and a highly personalized typing or gaming experience.
Snappy Tappy - continuously monitors 2 selected keys and dynamically prioritizes their inputs according to your configured settings. By reducing conflicting inputs, it enhances responsiveness, accuracy, and overall input reliability during gameplay.
The Chilkey SF60 keyboard uses WS Flux Poseidon magnetic switches. These switches use magnets and sensors instead of physical contacts to process actuations, creating a much smoother keypress without bounce or chatter. The adjustable actuation point is determined not by location but by distance travelled. This keyboard is not compatible with regular mechanical switches and due to manufacturing differences, may not be compatible with all magnetic or Hall Effect switches.

Lofree once again partnered with Kailh to rethink the switch from its physical structure. The result is something entirely new. The Nexus Mechanical Magnetic Switch is the first switch to truly combine the advantages of both magnetic and mechanical systems. It retains the precision and speed of magnetic actuation, while introducing the feedback and sound of a mechanical structure. In gaming, 0.01mm Rapid Trigger and dual 8K polling deliver faster, more precise input. In everyday use, the mechanical structure and gasket system provide stability, consistency, and a refined feel. At the same time, Hyzen supports hot-swappable compatibility with both magnetic and mechanical switches, allowing you to tailor your typing experience to different needs.
The Lofree Hyzen67 keyboard uses Lofree x Kailh Nexus Mechancial Magnetic switches. These switches use magnets and sensors instead of physical contacts to process actuations, creating a much smoother keypress without bounce or chatter. The adjustable actuation point is determined not by location but by distance travelled.
Hyzen is built on TMR (Tunnel MagnetoResistance) sensing technology — a next-generation magnetic sensing solution. Unlike traditional Hall Effect sensors that detect magnetic field strength, TMR measures resistance changes, allowing it to capture far more subtle variations in key travel. TMR also offers improved temperature stability, stronger resistance to interference and lower power consumption.
Adjustable Actuation
Adjust actuation point between 0.01mm to 3.5mm to strike the perfect balance between speed and control.
Rapid Trigger
Keys can reset and re-trigger instantly, without returning to the top position. This removes the physical limitation of traditional switches, bringing faster repeated inputs, more responsive movement and tighter control in high-speed scenarios.
Dynamic Keystroke (DKS)
One key. Multiple actions. In FPS games, a single press can smoothly trigger - aim, shoot, reset - allowing complex sequences (up to 4 actions) to happen in one motion.
Mod Tap
Tap for one action. Hold for another. In action or RPG games, you can combine - quick skills (tap), charged abilities (hold) - without moving your fingers.
Toggle
Turn continuous actions on or off. Perfect for auto-run in open-world games or repeated actions in farming or grinding. Free your fingers without losing control.
Rapid Successive Priority
When multiple keys are pressed, the deeper press takes priority. In competitive scenarios, this ensures intentional actions override accidental ones — critical for movement and control accuracy.
SOCD Directional Input Control
Manage conflicting inputs like left/right or up/down. Essential in fighting games (clean directional inputs) and PS movement (precise strafing and counter-strafing) to ensure your inputs stay clean and predictable.
Hyper Tap
Trigger multiple inputs with one key. In fast-paced games, this enables - jump + crouch combos, advanced movement shortcuts, complex macros without delay.

The Ducky One is designed with a narrower bezel compared to the previous Ducky keyboards, the thinnest bezel that we ever made. We tried to reduce the overall size without affecting the overall design of the keyboard. The keyboard looks much better with a modern, simple and minimalistic design.
The Ducky One with new designed that provided two-stage feet and it is different from the traditional monolithic feet. Users are able to change the angle for keyboard with the choice of three (feet folded, small feet and big feet).
Unlike the original Ducky mini-USB cable, Ducky One provides a cable that is more commonly used; the Micro USB data cable. Cable and keyboard can be separated.
ABS double shot keycaps are built by two different colors of plastic combined. The keycap surface and the character will not be worn out.
Double-shot keycaps are designed and engineered in a way to give the users the best feel and experience we can and at the same time decorated with special patterns to achieve the best look and usability all at once.
Under USB, the Ducky One can handle any number of simultaneous key presses. You can use the keyboard confidently in any situations knowing that there will never be ghosting or key blocking issue.
The Ducky One uses the fastest rate available under the USB interface, and updates the keyboard's status to the computer every 1 millisecond. This minimize the delay from when the keys are pressed and signal received by your computer.
Ducky brings adjustable repeat rate and repeat delay to USB keyboards. You can fine tune the repeat rate and repeat delay for gaming or your specific applications.
Note: USB Repeat Acceleration may work differently in different applications. Please use a suitable setting accordingly.
